title: @inth/vue: Vue cookie banner and cookie consent management
description: Cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center for Vue 3, with consent policies you set by location, such as GDPR opt-in or CCPA opt-out. A Vue plugin with composables when you want your own design. Nuxt apps use @inth/nuxt.
features: A Vue plugin for Vite apps, with `consentManifest()` to bundle your policy at build time
Prebuilt cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center with a theme system
Composables for a fully custom design
Analytics, ads, and pixels follow each visitor's choice through @inth/integrations: Google Tag Manager, Google Consent Mode v2, GA4, Meta Pixel, PostHog, and more
IAB TCF 2.4 banner and dialog components
prerequisites: An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), a [self-hosted backend](https://c15t.com/docs/self-host/quickstart), or local mode for development and tests
usage: Install the plugin with `app.use(inthVue, { mode: hosted() })` from `@inth/vue/vue-plugin`, and render `ConsentRoot` in `App.vue`
For the full setup, see the [Vue quickstart](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/vue/quickstart)
